avis.texte: This mask is super hydrating and calming for my skin which I love, but I wont be repurchasing for the fact the mask lifted nonstop the whole time I was wearing it. If I wasn't completely still the whole time I was wearing it, it started falling off. I even made slits around the mask and that still didnt help, sadly ruined the mask for me.

Ive been in the look out for a hydrating face mask and this mask is now a MUST after a full skincare routine. I usually do a full reset skincare 2x a month with a dermaplane and after toning serums and moisturizer this mask sealed everything together. I had slept with it over night and the next morning my skin was super hydrated glowing and help some redness. 100% recommend it! Helps to make some slits around the nose and eye area to help ut fit your face.
I love how it hydrates the skin and my skin does get a good glow. It was easy to put on and it does take a while to dry. I will be pairing this with a hyaluronic serum for better results.
works great - love it. Just wish I could buy a bulk pack of these instead of individual ones or just get the secret sauce to put on my own reusable mask.

Mask took 2 hrs to get clear. It stayed in place while I cleaned which was nice! Sadly the mask didnt feel hydrating "enough" as skin felt somewhat still dry. I have used hyaluronic acid serum that leaves me feeling much better. Skin type is oily-combination.
This is a great "glass mask". It took about 4 hours to turn completely clear. When I took it off all fine lines were gone and my skin was glowing.

avis.titre: New hydrating mask from medi heal
avis.texte: I am amazed I have worn some pretty hydrating mask that costed more than this mask but it does wonders. affordable and something to do on after a stressful day. the mask does go transparent after 2 hours as instructed. I also think this is a good stocking stuffer or something to with friend and post pictures. left my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed
